verdict.line: You lose standing in extended melee trades that let Mordekaiser land his third attack or spell for Darkness Rise and then shield-into-heal with Indestructible; you win short E-stun-into-Q-reset trades that deny those stacks and punish his W cooldown.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Darkness Rise passive only triggers after he lands three attacks or spells on you, and Indestructible (W) is what lets him heal through long fights — so this matchup is entirely about trade length. Irelia's kit is built for short trades: E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks, Q (Bladesurge) refreshes instantly off a Marked or killed target, and that dash can reset onto a minion just as easily as a champion to disengage. Stay in his face past the third hit and you lose the fight on his terms; dash in, stun, hit, and leave, and you win it on yours.

theirWindow.when: after he lands 3 hits on you
theirWindow.what: His passive (Darkness Rise) just gave him a damage aura and bonus Move Speed off that third landed attack or spell. Stop trading immediately — Q (Bladesurge) onto a minion to reposition out rather than continuing to swing.

yourWindow.what: He has no shield-into-heal safety net right now. Open with E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Q (Bladesurge) onto him to refresh instantly and keep hitting while you're near max Ionian Fervor (passive) stacks.

powerCurve.note: Even pokes; neither has reliable all-in
E unlocks stun into Q reset
R and W online; respect his all-in
Blade of The Ruined King offsets his W healing
Attack-speed snowball and R wall win skirmishes

start.why: Sustains the early short trades and adds enough damage that a single Q dash onto him or a minion still stings, without committing you to a long fight.

boots.why: Mordekaiser's entire kit — Obliterate (Q), Death's Grasp (E), Realm of Death (R) — is magic damage, so MR directly cuts his burst in any trade that goes long.

core.why: The on-hit percent-health damage and active slow pair with Ionian Fervor's stacking attack speed, turning your hit-and-run Qs into real sustained pressure once you're ahead.
This is an even lane you win by converting skirmish advantage into sidelane pressure rather than forcing dives — Hullbreaker scales that split-push plan.
More magic resist plus on-hit damage directly answers his all-magic burst while keeping the attack-speed snowball going.

situational.when: he's chaining Death's Grasp (E) into Obliterate (Q) or landing Realm of Death (R) and you need to survive the burst window instead of trading through it
mordekaiser is ahead and threatening to end fights outright with Realm of Death rather than you controlling the trade
you're committing to a pure on-hit skirmish plan over Hullbreaker's split-push wincon

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks on the repeated spell and auto hits inside your dash-stun-dash combos, giving you sustained damage and healing in skirmishes that offsets his Indestructible self-heal.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes his Indestructible (W) healing during the exact all-in window you're looking for — when his shield is down — and Flash lets you commit to or bail out of the dash-stun combo safely.

playing.title: Trade short, dash out
playing.detail: Use Q (Bladesurge) on a minion near him to disengage right after your stun combo lands, before he gets his third hit in for Darkness Rise. Never stand in prolonged melee once that aura is up.

playing.title: Open with E, not Q
playing.detail: Lead combos with E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Q (Bladesurge) onto the Marked target to refresh its cooldown instantly and keep stacking Ionian Fervor.

playing.title: All-in when his W is down
playing.detail: Indestructible is 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown — track it and commit once it's down and you're holding max passive stacks for the bonus on-hit damage.

playing.title: Respect Death's Grasp range
playing.detail: E pulls all enemies in its area at 700 range. Don't facetank static trades near minion waves where that pull can chain straight into Obliterate (Q).

playing.title: Don't overextend into his ultimate
playing.detail: Once he hits level 6 for Realm of Death, avoid committing to trades you can't finish in one rotation — his ult can still swing an isolated duel even though you hold the overall solo-kill edge.

playing.title: Itemize magic resist early
playing.detail: Mercury's Treads into Wit's End blunts his fully magic kit over time, letting your on-hit damage close the gap in extended skirmishes.

playing.title: Convert with Hullbreaker and the R wall
playing.detail: Once the lane is even or ahead, push sidelane with Hullbreaker and use R's resulting wall of blades — which damages and slows anyone walking through it — to zone him off rather than forcing a risky dive.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and the win rate/sample size figures above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (2,006 games); the trade-pattern and timing analysis is my own reading of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Create some distance with [Q] to prevent Mordekaiser from using his (P). Engage when Mordekaiser’s (W) shield is on cooldown and Irelia has 4 stacks [P] prepared.
